imgs.alt: Six relationship conventions plus the exact delay categories used in V7. Authority does not carry a causal sign or close loops.
Loop R1: A1 to B1 through L01 positive; B1 to E1 through L02 positive and plausible; E1 to A1 through L03 positive. The middle step is the weakest.
R16 has one supported forward link L26 and one hypothetical return link T01. The return is dashed and explicitly unconfirmed.
Reform R-28 is attached to link L03 with a red target bracket. The bracket is not a causal edge. Owner, delivery requirement, intended effect, and evidence are separate.
